body: Built: adapters/gdrive, dropbox, onedrive, vercelblob, cloudinary (plain REST, stdlib only, own TokenSource interface), contrib/pickers (Import via upload.Receive, guarded client, token confined to source origins), examples/pickers-import, docs/adapters/{gdrive,dropbox,onedrive,vercelblob,cloudinary,supabase}.md, docs/plugins/pickers.md. Each module: conformance vs in-process fake, break-verified tests. Skipped per owner: Uploadcare, Instagram. Real-account gaps listed in each README.
